statement: The deposited GraphSAGE PPI split is incompatible with the manuscript edge thresholds when applied to the current released OhmNet edgelists.
evidence: astrocyte and basophil training layers have 9,635 and 4,193 raw edge records; midbrain test has 31,665, below the stated 15,000/35,000 cutoffs.
status: confirmed for current release; historical cause unresolved

statement: The midbrain test layer is a descendant and exact subnetwork of the brain training layer.
evidence: all 2,310 midbrain tissue-instance rows are present in training; midbrain nodes and edges are contained in brain.
report_action: state as a limitation of the unseen-graph interpretation
